integrity: No Week 2 official roster identity, tip, confidence or frozen decision is created from predicted-team reporting. New injury labels are persisted only where a source states them. Egan Butcher remains a Week 2 unavailability negative; Sam Walker and Dylan Lucas remain unresolved contradictions; Siua Wong (ribs), Lindsay Collins (leg), Jacob Laban (knee) and Jackson Ford (ankle) are availability monitors; Dallin Watene-Zelezniak is an expected-return signal only.
